description:
Part of epic ag-o6z; read it first. Work is in the central pipelines repo xpmatteo/agbredo-pipelines (local checkout ../pipelines next to this repo), not in agbredo. That repo has no bw tracker, so its tickets live here.

## Goal

The agent instructions audit pipeline marks each PR it opens with the run that opened it, so Agbredo can link it as "declared".

## What to build

- actions/agent-instructions-audit/scripts/open-pr.sh: add a line `Agbredo-Run: $GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT` on its own line at the end of .audit/pr.md (after the existing run footer). Keep the existing footer.
- README.md: a short section "Marking escalations for Agbredo": any pipeline that opens a PR adds this trailer line to the PR body; Agbredo links the PR to the run only when the PR author is a bot, the branch is in the same repository and the PR was opened during that run; otherwise the PR is still recorded, as inferred or unlinked, with a finding.
- Release: callers pin `@v1`, and v1 is a tag (`git ls-remote` shows refs/tags/v1). Releasing means moving the v1 tag, which changes what every caller runs next. Ask Matt before moving it. See the README "Versions" section and ticket ag-s99.10 for how it was done before.

## How to check

Run the audit once (workflow_dispatch in xpmatteo/rpg-interpreter, after closing open audit PR so the gate does not skip) and see the trailer in the new PR body. With ag-o6z.4 deployed, the run page shows the PR as declared.

comments.text: Merged to pipelines main as 5e8621d, pushed, v1 tag moved to it (Matt approved). Review: no bugs; nit 'tail -c1 guard is dead code' kept as harmless defence.

title: Pipelines: add the Agbredo-Run trailer to audit PRs
